tasks.instruction: Read AGENTS.md, MUSE.md and MUSE-55. Implement a bounded repeatable CPU connected-sight benchmark using existing sampleSight and POSES from tools/connected-sight-probe.js. Allowed writes tools/connected-sight-bench.js and docs/qa/muse55-connected-cost.md only. Do not change kernel, fixtures, existing tests or queue. Measure all three existing poses, grid 96x72, 2 warmups and 9 measured repeats, report min/median/p90/max wall sample milliseconds and query-only milliseconds separately, work distributions, counts by unresolved reason, at-budget counts. Include CPU model, OS, Node version, scene path, HEAD, grid/range/work defaults. Preserve first observed sample as cold-in-process (not shader or cold OS) separately. Confirm counts/work repeat identically across repeats; fail if not. Output concise JSON to a provided --out path; cap supported repeats and validate positive integers. No dependencies. Run benchmark once on your host and report observed numbers (not GPU frame times), then stop READY FOR REVIEW. No full test suite needed: standalone measurement tool only; node --check plus benchmark execution. Do not launch other agents. Keep report under 600 words.
